Question
========
What does the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) do?

Answerlist
----------
* It discounts a country's human development achievements by the inequality in their distribution
* It measures only income inequality
* It ranks countries by the wealth of the top 1%
* It replaces GDP with happiness surveys

Solution
========
The IHDI shows how much human development is lost due to inequality in health, education, and income.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
